description: Replace the accept-any placeholder with real allowlist matching. A Guest allowlist reader fetches the Guests tab and parses rows to a Guest shape (skipping empty/header rows, blank party_id meaning a party of one). A pure name matcher normalizes case/space/accents/punctuation and resolves a typed name to matched | ambiguous | none — exact full-name first, then a one-typo token match on first/last name. Matched issues the access cookie with the real guestId/partyId; ambiguous prompts for the full name; no-match shows a retry plus a real contact line and never reveals any names. Validation is HITL: deploy and have the couple test entry against the live Guest List.
title: Allowlist matching: resolve a typed name against the Guest List
acceptance_criteria: A listed Guest's name (including a single typo or first-name-only) is matched and granted access
A name shared by two Guests returns ambiguous and prompts for the full name, which then resolves to one
An unlisted name is refused with a retry and a contact fallback, leaking no names
The issued cookie carries the matched guest's real guestId and partyId
The name matcher is unit-tested over a fixture list: normalize, exact, one-typo, first-name-only, two-name ambiguity, and no-match
Deployed and confirmed by the couple against the live Guest List
